name: Humanitarian funding gap
value: WFP cuts rations: Sudan, Chad, South Sudan
summary: WFP is cutting food aid in Sudan, Chad and South Sudan as funding falls; caseload cuts, not a full suspension
state: WFP said in September that it is reducing food assistance across Sudan, South Sudan and Chad, cutting rations for displaced people in Tawila and El Obeid and, in Chad, prioritising new arrivals among about 1.4 million Sudanese refugees (WFP, 22 Sep). Reuters reported on 14 Sep that WFP funding for Sudan had fallen sharply as hunger rose (via TimesLIVE). Searches on 14 Nov found no formal large-scale suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country, so Watch is kept.
for_you: Refugees and displaced people in Sudan, Chad and South Sudan are most exposed to ration cuts. Host governments and aid agencies face rising needs with less money.
rubric_hit: Major ration cuts announced (Watch); no large-scale pipeline break or suspension (Alert line)

sources.title: WFP — Sudan fallout: how shrinking aid is deepening one of the world's biggest hunger crises
TimesLIVE (Reuters) — World Food Programme funding for Sudan plummets as more go hungry, head says

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
